headline.study: option (b): magnetic detents above the panel, nonmagnetic mechanical retention

recommendation.architecture: B1: radial-gap rotor/stator pair entirely above the panel; 24 rotor blocks in the knob skirt + 4 stator blocks (each a stack of 2) in a PEEK carrier
recommendation.magnets: Sm2Co17 (RECOMA 35E class, Br 1.19 T), block 2.0 radial x 2.5 tangential x 1.8 axial mm, magnetised through the 2.0 mm (radial, outward); 24 rotor + 8 stator pieces = 32 identical blocks

monte_carlo_recommended.scatter_model: per-piece strength sigma 1.5 %, magnetisation direction sigma 1.5 deg, position sigma 0.05 mm per axis; lots Br and gap uniform within the tolerance set, running offset +-0.1 mm, axial offset +-0.3 mm, tilt sigma 0.5 deg

monte_carlo_catalogue.scatter_model: per-piece strength sigma 1.5 %, magnetisation direction sigma 1.5 deg, position sigma 0.05 mm per axis; lots Br and gap uniform within the tolerance set, running offset +-0.1 mm, axial offset +-0.3 mm, tilt sigma 0.5 deg

demag.note: rigid-magnet superposition, H of all sources at nodes inside each block (self field included). The knee Hk of the demagnetisation curve lies below HcJ and is only a plot in the datasheet: the margin is against HcJ (a necessary, not a sufficient, condition) [UNVERIFIED knee]

eddy.basis: 2 rev/s; T = sigma * omega * integral(r^2 Bz^2) dV (conductor currents do not react on the field: magnetic Reynolds number ~0.04); the shell term uses |B|^2 (upper bound); sigma_5052 2.0e7, sigma_6061 3.0e7 S/m; Monte Carlo integration

thermal_gap.basis: dgap = (alpha_knob r_rotor - alpha_carrier r_stator) (176 - 20) K; typical coefficients [ASSUMED]

induced_by_smco_permeability_chi0p10.note: upper bound: induced M = chi H of the sensing magnet at each block centre, no self-demagnetisation, chi=0.10 (recoil permeability 1.05-1.10)

retention.concept: 3 ball plungers (Si3N4 balls, BeCu or Elgiloy springs) in the knob skirt engage a 35 deg flank groove in the PEEK carrier; groove axial width = ball footprint + 0.8 mm so that the 0.65 mm push never rides the flank
retention.formula: F = n P (tan(beta) + mu) / (1 - mu tan(beta)) + F_magnetic(0.8 mm), sliding friction at the ball seat; rolling friction ignored (pessimistic for the lower bound)
retention.status: ESTIMATE, not proved: the friction band, the spring rate and the wear over 5 000 removals are fixture measurements

cost.method: public list prices read on the web by a read-only fetch on 2026-10-12; nothing was ordered or quoted. EUR as shown, ex VAT. No USD list price for a small Sm2Co17 block with a >= 1 000 piece tier was found; the Euromag block is a larger block, so the per-piece number is a proxy for a custom-ground 2.0 x 2.5 x 1.8 mm block.

sources.source: Euromag shop, SmCo blocks ref 3312B871 (6 x 4 x 2 and 20 x 10 x 2.5 mm, Sm2Co17, 350 C, thickness-magnetised)
sources.note: which variant the tiers apply to is not stated; above 1 001 pieces 'contact seller'

sources.source: DigiKey, Radial Magnets 8997 (469-1026-ND), SmCo5 (1:5) cylinder 6 x 3 mm, diametric
sources.note: 1:5 not 2:17, larger than the block; a lower bound

assumptions.high_basis: custom grind of an 8-15 mm^3 block, 1.8 x the Euromag 1 001+ tier [ASSUMED, no source states a premium]

cost.not_costed: carrier, covers, balls, springs, locator bands, assembly, coating, magnetisation and grading: no sourced prices

r44.frame: front-local, knob axis at (110, 53), w outward, fascia front w = 0, rear w = -3

rotor_magnets.magnetisation: radial, outward (same pole facing the stators: N outer faces attract S inner faces)
rotor_magnets.angle_origin: a rotor block aligned with every stator block at the detent centre; theta = 0 and every 15 deg

knob.magnet_pocket: closed on the stator side by a 0.10 mm nonmagnetic cover; pockets capture the blocks mechanically (no adhesive credit)
knob.underside_height_at_rest_w_mm: <= 0.8 over r 19.5..28 so that the rotor blocks (w 1.6..3.4) and the 0.65 mm push do not touch the carrier floor

carrier.material: glass- or carbon-filled PEEK or PPS (expansion about 22 ppm/K [ASSUMED typical], NOT unfilled PEEK at 47 ppm/K: it would close the gap by 0.08 mm at 176 C, thermal_gap), pockets captured mechanically, no steel
carrier.fixing: to the blind formed feature of the 3 mm fascia: 3 titanium (grade 5) or brass M2 screws on r = 19.5 at 0, 120, 240 deg into blind tapped holes of depth <= 2 mm (1 mm of fascia stays intact, nothing passes through); no ferromagnetic screw inside r 25

forces_to_hold.note: each block is pulled outward ~0.76 N by the rotor ring; the four loads cancel in the carrier

locator_and_retention.retention_groove_w_mm: above the magnets, between the lands
locator_and_retention.note: the lands must sit above the magnets (w > 4.2) so that knob tilt does not move the rotor ring radially

r44.outside_r25: the detent magnets are inside r 25 (stators r 21.5..23.5) because they are not steel; no steel, no ferromagnetic fastener, spring, ball or bearing anywhere inside r 25 or elsewhere in the knob/carrier: balls Si3N4, springs BeCu/Elgiloy, bands Ti or PEEK, screws Ti/brass. SmCo's own permeability is bounded in section 'permeability'.
r44.rear_of_fascia: nothing is added behind the fascia: the three tab standoffs (83,42), (83,64), (138,53), J9 (82,53), U7 and the tab size are unchanged by this design (unlike option (a) in knob-ring, which needed r >= 29 for the standoffs and a 67.5 mm tab). Only the blind tapped holes of the carrier (r 19.5) are on the rear face's opposite side: they must not break through, and the rear face must stay flat for the standoffs.

tolerances_required.rotor/stator ring concentricity_in_servi: <= 0.10 mm running offset, 0.30 mm at 10 N lateral load
tolerances_required.magnet_dimensions_mm: +-0.05 and block-to-block strength +-1.5 %, direction +-1.5 deg, position +-0.05 mm (the Monte Carlo scatter)

r44.sensor_side: the sensing magnet position (w 1..6) is not changed; the die stays at (110, 53, w -4); keep-out radius 25 for steel is respected (zero steel); the detent assembly adds about 1.2 mT of Bz at the die (0.4 mT of it from the stators) and no X/Y field in the ideal case
r44.sealing_ESD: carrier sealed to the fascia by a captured seal of identified compound (not chosen here); discharge path from the knob shell to the fascia through the conductive contacts of the SPEC is unchanged and must not pass through the carrier (PEEK is insulating); the exposed 0.10 mm covers are the wash-down surface
